label: Ticket
mood: printed ephemera carrying the event's information — an admission ticket with notched ends, a perforated stub printed in a second ink, the headline in the display face and the date, time and place as captioned fields; a boarding-pass-like pass with a header band and two large codes; or a long paper receipt in the mono face with zigzag ends, the information rows as line items and the fee as its total. Flat inks on card and paper with a soft shadow, a seeded serial number and a barcode of plain bars; the words are the copy's own, verbatim. Good for concerts, screenings, festivals, parties, fairs, markets, workshops and any event with an entry, a fee or a free pass.

orient.note: admit and pass: auto (horizontal in a wide room, a vertical ticket in a tall one) | horizontal | vertical

tilt.note: degrees the ticket is turned (the direction is seeded); empty = a few degrees, 0 = square to the page

admit.note: an admission ticket: notched ends, a perforated stub in the second ink, the headline, date / time / place as captioned fields, 입장권 · ADMIT ONE, a serial number and a barcode, tilted

pass.note: a boarding-pass-like pass: a header band with the headline, two large codes (the date and the time), captioned fields for place and price, a barcode on the stub

receipt.note: a long paper receipt in the mono face with zigzag ends: header, dashed rules, the information rows as line items, the fee (or 무료 / FREE) as the total, a barcode
